businesses.business: Infrastructure, material handling and safety equipment

offering_description.value: Manufactures equipment for infrastructure cleaning and maintenance, material handling and emergency signaling. It serves municipal and industrial customers and provides equipment distribution, custom truck upfitting and road-marking services.

quotes.quote: Federal Signal manufactures a broad range of equipment engineered to improve, enhance and safeguard communities, companies and their infrastructure around the world.

As an organization, we are relentless in our commitment to our customers to build and deliver equipment of unmatched quality that moves material, cleans infrastructure, and protects the communities where we live and work.
